description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
